THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
FoundationProposed standardUse
Spacing4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 64 px8 px base with 4 px substeps.
Content widthApproximately 1200 pxCentered content area with responsive page padding.
Radius8 / 12 / 16 pxControls, cards and larger containers.
Grid12 desktop / 4 mobile columnsConsistent content alignment. Proposed implementation extension.
Primary button48 px heightKeep the label short and meaningful.
Touch targetRecommended 44 × 44 pxSeparate adjacent controls and keep focus visible.
01

Creative hierarchy

Brand anchor → headline → relevant visual → action → legible terms.

02

Density

One dominant message per panel. Leave quiet space around the headline.

03

Small screens

Stack content by reading priority. Avoid shrinking a desktop composition into a narrow screen.
